text: dsh-subagent-models 是一个面向 DSH 网页端的子代理模型选择插件，可分别设置全局默认和单个对话的覆盖值。它在输入框旁添加入口，并通过 Host 的 agent/request 事件为委派子代理应用 provider、model 和 reasoning effort；顶层会话保持原有模型选择。用户可以从实时模型目录按提供方查找模型、选择模型公布的思考强度，并查看当前生效路线。适合需要让委派任务使用指定模型或强度的 DSH 用户。插件将路由保存到本机 JSON 文件，不需要额外 API Key。

dsh-subagent-models lets DSH web users set global or per-conversation models for delegated agents. A composer chip opens searchable model and reasoning-effort pickers backed by the live catalog. The Host applies the route to child requests and stores settings locally; no extra API key is needed.

dsh-subagent-models 的功能「按对话指定子代理路线」：在输入框旁打开卡片，选择本对话范围并挑选模型。保存后，该对话委派出的子代理请求会使用所选 provider、model 和 reasoning effort。
dsh-subagent-models 的功能「设置全局子代理默认模型」：从同一张卡片切换到全局默认范围并选择模型。没有单独对话覆盖时，委派子代理请求应用这个默认路线。
dsh-subagent-models 的功能「浏览可用模型」：打开模型菜单并输入搜索词，插件从 DSH 的实时模型目录展示匹配结果并按提供方分组，用户可选择委派任务所用的模型。
dsh-subagent-models 的功能「选择模型思考强度」：选择模型后打开强度菜单，可选模型公布的 reasoning effort 或模型默认值；选定值随子代理的模型请求生效。
dsh-subagent-models 将路由配置写入本机 plugin-data/subagent-models.json；数据目录由 DSH_HOME 决定，未设置时使用 ~/.dsh。
怎么让子代理继续跟随主会话，或者改用指定模型？
I need delegated agents to use a model-specific reasoning level.

**one entry**, the chip beside the composer. The card it opens has two scopes over the same two
DSH-style pickers: a searchable, provider-grouped model menu and that model's own effort menu.

dsh-subagent-models README · dsh-subagent-models：- Host half: route store + `agent/request` override (`index.js`)
- Web half: the composer chip + a frame-wide card (`client.js`)
- No build step and no settings page. The Web half uses the host's
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` when present (a frozen platform module — nothing to
  install), with hand-drawn `.dsm-*` fallbacks on hosts that do not ship it.

dsh-subagent-models README · Where to set it / 在哪里设置：The chip's label is the **effective** route for the conversation (e.g. `子代理 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ·
high`), so the composer always says what a delegation will actually use. The card's footer repeats
it with its source: `下一次委派将使用 …（来源：本对话 / 全局默认）`.
section: Where to set it / 在哪里设置

text:
dsh-subagent-models README · Where to set it / 在哪里设置：The card's two rows are DSH-style cells — click one to open a menu anchored above it. The model
menu matches the built-in composer model picker: a search box for catalogs above four models,
provider groups with sticky headings, rounded hover rows and an inline check mark on the current
choice. The effort menu lists 「模型默认」 plus only the levels that model advertises.
section: Where to set it / 在哪里设置

text:
dsh-subagent-models README · Where to set it / 在哪里设置：Both menus are driven by the live LLM catalog (`ctx.llm`): models are grouped by provider, and the
effort list is the one **that model** advertises (`resolveModelInfo().reasoning.efforts`), so an
unsupported level is never offered.

> No settings page is registered by this plugin. The built-in 设置 → 插件 → 子智能体 page belongs to
> dsh itself (recursion depth, concurrency, model whitelist) and is unrelated; see below.

dsh-subagent-models README · Precedence / 优先级：```
本对话 override  →  全局默认  →  no route (child inherits the parent session)
```

dsh-subagent-models README · When it takes effect / 什么时候生效：- Applies to the **next delegation** — no restart, no new conversation.
- A child that is already running picks it up on its **next model request**.
- With no route configured, children keep inheriting the parent session's route — exactly the
  behaviour of not installing the plugin.

text:
dsh-subagent-models README · How the route is applied / 怎么生效：The delegation tool (`subagent`) is composed in the **agent-plane preset**, not in the Profile
patch, and it carries its own static `agentOptions`. A plugin cannot rewrite that composition, so
the route is applied one level lower:

```
agent/request  (waterfall: "replace the frozen call configuration")
```

The listener is registered once and only rewrites an Agent that another live Agent owns — a
delegated child. A top-level Session is never touched. Consequences:

dsh-subagent-models README · Data / 数据：`$DSH_HOME/plugin-data/subagent-models.json` (falls back to `~/.dsh/plugin-data/`), hot-reloaded on
mtime, so editing it by hand also works:

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "global": {
    "default": { "provider": "deepseek-official", "model": "deepseek-flash", "effort": "high" },

`global.default: null` means no profile default; an absent `sessions[sessionId]` means the
conversation follows it.

dsh-subagent-models README · Data / 数据：Capability disclosure: reads and writes this one JSON file; binds no network port beyond the loopback
HTTP prefix `/plugin/subagent-models` used by the Web UI; never reads conversation content,
credentials, or any other file.

dsh-subagent-models README · Limits / 限制：- `subagent_fork` children are overridden too. A fork shares the parent's prefix, so a different
  model costs its KV cache; clear the route (or keep the preset's own `agentOptions`) if that
  matters to you.
- An effort the chosen model does not support fails the adapter's validation — the plugin never
  silently downgrades.
- The override is per request. Context-window and metering metadata follow the effective route,
  while the child's creation options keep the preset's values.

dsh-subagent-models README · Relationship to similar plugins / 与同类插件的关系：Several plugins in the market move subagent routing: `dsh-subagent-custom` (task-class routing),
`dsh-subagent-model-picker` (a per-session picker), `dsh-subagent-default-model` (settings.yaml
default), `dsh-model-settings` (a settings panel), `dsh-orquestrator` (a fixed forced route). This
one keeps the surface at one composer chip: two scopes, one pair of DSH-style pickers, and a label
that always shows the effective value.
